mutants.description: Strike blink stops as soon as the supervisor re-enters S_RUN, as if a successful retry ended the strikes, instead of lasting through the clean-run window until clean_run_target clears strike_level
mutants.reason: After a hiccup, once the retry's soft-start ends and run_active rises while strike_level is still non-zero, Red_LED1 goes dark at once instead of blinking for about a second. It still blinks in S_HICCUP and S_SS.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is suppressed while the output is in regulation, as if an input UVLO with the rail still good had to be a comparator glitch
mutants.reason: If debounced uvlo_state rises while pgood is still high (the output holding up as the input sags, before the supervisor shuts down), Red_LED3 stays dark. It lights only after pgood falls, although it should follow uvlo_state directly.

mutants.description: Latched-trip solid indication is made sticky until reset (the SCR 'cannot be un-tripped'), so once Red_LED1 is lit with no strikes outstanding it never clears from the latch inputs
mutants.reason: If latch_state rises from the hardware path without latch_assert or strikes, then the debounced readback falls again, Red_LED1 stays solid until rst_n instead of going dark. Also, any lit strike-blink half that is showing when strike_level clears holds Red_LED1 on indefinitely.
